"""Scoped static models for Win16 seg3:3a7a/3acc/3b16/31aa/3360.
No Windows palette driver, physical DAC display, game runtime or timing emulation.
"""
def dac_palette_writes(rgb):
    if len(rgb)!=768:raise ValueError('256 RGB triples required')
    return [(0x3c8,0)]+[(0x3c9,c>>2) for c in rgb]

def dac_entry_writes(index,rgb):
    if len(rgb)!=3:raise ValueError('RGB triple required')
    return [(0x3c8,index&255)]+[(0x3c9,(c&255)>>2) for c in rgb]

def gdi_initial_entries(rgb,system_entries,reserve_system):
    """LOGPALETTE entry payload for31aa param2=0; initial system RGB supplied."""
    if len(rgb)!=768 or len(system_entries)!=1024:raise ValueError('invalid palette size')
    out=bytearray(system_entries)
    for i in range(256):out[4*i+3]=0
    reserved=10 if reserve_system else 0
    for i in range(reserved,256-reserved):out[4*i:4*i+4]=rgb[3*i:3*i+3]+b'\x01'
    return bytes(out)

def gdi_animation_payload(rgb):
    """31aa param2=2: start10,count236, RGB flags1."""
    if len(rgb)!=768:raise ValueError('invalid palette size')
    return b''.join(rgb[i*3:i*3+3]+b'\x01' for i in range(10,246))

def palette_entries_to_bgr0(entries):
    if len(entries)!=1024:raise ValueError('256 entries required')
    return bytes(v for i in range(256) for v in (entries[4*i+2],entries[4*i+1],entries[4*i],0))

def page_swap_words(c0,c2):
    """Direct-mode arithmetic only: exchange globals and produce OUT 3d4,AX."""
    c0,c2=c2&65535,c0&65535
    data=(((c0>>8)&255)<<4)&255
    return c0,c2,0x0c|(data<<8)

def first_status_read(values,mask,wanted):
    """Finite fixture; original loop has no timeout, and tests current level."""
    for reads,value in enumerate(values,1):
        if bool(value&mask)==wanted:return reads
    raise ValueError('fixture ended before condition, original loop would keep polling')

if __name__=='__main__':
    import json,struct,hashlib
    from pathlib import Path
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    p=(root/'prior/inputs/nite3w - 110.exe').read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(p).hexdigest()=='12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481'
    ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',p,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',p,ne+0x22)[0];shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',p,ne+0x32)[0]
    off,size,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',p,st+16);c=p[off<<shift:(off<<shift)+size]
    for addr,h in [(0x3ad0,'33c0bac803eeb90003'),(0x3ade,'8a04c0e8022ae4bac903ee46'),
                    (0x3a8c,'8b1ec000871ec200891ec000'),(0x3aa0,'fab00c8ae7c0e404bad403effb'),
                    (0x3ac2,'bada03eca80874f8cb'),(0x3b58,'8a46062ae4bac803ee'),
                    (0x3b61,'8a4608c0e802bac903ee8a460ac0e802ee8a460cc0e802ee'),
                    (0x31bc,'66c786f2fb00030001'),(0x321c,'803eaf4601f51bc983e10a'),
                    (0x3307,'83c61e'),(0x3319,'c6450301'),(0x3332,'6668ec000a00'),
                    (0x32b5,'88849c4d'),(0x32bd,'88849b4d'),(0x32c5,'88849a4d'),
                    (0x32c9,'c6849d4d00')]:
        b=bytes.fromhex(h);assert c[addr:addr+len(b)]==b,hex(addr)
    assert c[0x3af7:0x3afe]==bytes.fromhex('803eb04600740c')
    assert c[0x3b02]==0x9a and struct.unpack_from('<H',c,0x3b03)[0]==0x3acc
    assert c[0x3b0e]==0x9a and struct.unpack_from('<H',c,0x3b0f)[0]==0x31aa
    off,_,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',p,st+9*8)
    assert struct.unpack_from('<2H',p,(off<<shift)+0xc0)==(0xa000,0xa400)
    assert all((v>>2)==v//4 and 0<=v>>2<=63 for v in range(256))
    assert all(sum((v>>2)==q for v in range(256))==4 for q in range(64))
    for flag in range(256):
        carry_from_compare=flag<1
        carry_after_cmc=not carry_from_compare
        reserved=(0xffff if carry_after_cmc else 0)&10
        assert reserved==(10 if flag else 0)
    fixtures=[]
    for pattern in range(3):
        rgb=bytes(((i*17)^(i>>2)^(pattern*71))&255 for i in range(768))
        system=bytes((i*29+pattern)&255 for i in range(1024))
        trace=dac_palette_writes(rgb);assert len(trace)==769 and trace[0]==(0x3c8,0)
        for i in range(256):assert dac_entry_writes(i,rgb[3*i:3*i+3])[1:]==trace[1+3*i:1+3*i+3]
        for reserve in (False,True):
            entries=gdi_initial_entries(rgb,system,reserve)
            r=10 if reserve else 0
            for i in range(256):
                expected=rgb[i*3:i*3+3]+b'\x01' if r<=i<256-r else system[i*4:i*4+3]+b'\x00'
                assert entries[i*4:i*4+4]==expected
            dib=palette_entries_to_bgr0(entries)
            assert all(dib[4*i:4*i+4]==bytes((entries[4*i+2],entries[4*i+1],entries[4*i],0)) for i in range(256))
        payload=gdi_animation_payload(rgb);assert len(payload)==236*4
        assert payload[:4]==rgb[30:33]+b'\x01' and payload[-4:]==rgb[735:738]+b'\x01'
        fixtures.append(dict(pattern=pattern,dac_values_sha256=hashlib.sha256(bytes(v for _,v in trace[1:])).hexdigest()))
    a,b=0xa000,0xa400;ports=[]
    for i in range(100):
        a,b,word=page_swap_words(a,b);ports.append(word)
        assert word==(0x400c if i%2==0 else 0x000c)
    for high in range(256):
        _,_,word=page_swap_words(0,high<<8);assert word==(((high<<4)&255)<<8)|0x0c
    assert first_status_read([8],8,True)==1
    assert first_status_read([0,0,8],8,True)==3
    assert first_status_read([8,0,8],8,True)==1
    assert first_status_read([1,1,0],1,False)==3
    summary=dict(component_inputs_exhaustive=256,dac_outputs=64,values_per_dac_output=4,
        rgb_fixtures=3,single_entry_cases=768,gdi_init_cases=6,gdi_animation_count=236,
        gdi_animation_first_index=10,gdi_animation_last_index=245,page_swap_iterations=100,
        crtc_high_byte_cases=256,status_trace_cases=4,runtime_tests=0,pixel_parity_proven=False,fixtures=fixtures)
    (root/'pass6/palette_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

"""Static model of Win16 1.10 seg3:ba74; no real timer, DAC or sound runtime."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FlashState:
    countdown:int
    phase:int

def enabled(episode,level_index):
    episode&=65535
    level=(level_index+1)&65535
    signed_level=level if level<32768 else level-65536
    return episode!=2 and (episode!=3 or signed_level>=10)

def step(state,episode,level_index,initialize=False,random_value=None,remap=None):
    """Returns final state, ordered calls, optional remap, self-mapping write.
    Countdown wraps as word; phase is tested as byte/nonzero. Intermediate old-zero
    decrement stores FFFF before the branch rewrites the countdown.
    """
    if not enabled(episode,level_index):return state,[],remap,None
    if initialize:
        if remap is not None and len(remap)!=256:raise ValueError('256-byte table required')
        updated=None if remap is None else bytearray(0xdb if x==0xda else x for x in remap)
        # DS:816e is DS:8094 + DA, not a separate variable.
        if updated is not None:
            updated[0xda]=0xda
            updated=bytes(updated)
        return FlashState(80,0),[('palette',0xda,0,0,0)],updated,0xda
    old=state.countdown&65535
    decremented=(old-1)&65535
    phase=state.phase&255
    if old:return FlashState(decremented,phase),[],remap,None
    if phase:
        if random_value is None or not 0<=random_value<=32767:raise ValueError('one RNG result 0..32767 required')
        count=random_value%240+160
        return FlashState(count,0),[('rng',),('palette',0xda,0,0,0),('sound',66,0,2)],remap,None
    return FlashState(3,1),[('palette',0xda,255,255,255)],remap,None

if __name__=='__main__':
    import json,hashlib,struct
    from pathlib import Path
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    p=(root/'prior/inputs/nite3w - 110.exe').read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(p).hexdigest()=='12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481'
    ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',p,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',p,ne+0x22)[0];shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',p,ne+0x32)[0]
    off,n,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',p,st+16);c=p[off<<shift:(off<<shift)+n]
    assert 0x8094+0xda==0x816e
    for addr,h in [(0xba99,'c606f03800c706ee385000'),(0xbaa6,'80bf9480da7505c6879480db'),
                   (0xbabe,'b0daa26e8150'),(0xbac6,'a1ee38ff0eee380bc0'),
                   (0xbad8,'c606f03800'),(0xbae2,'b9f00099f7f981c2a0008916ee38'),
                   (0xbb08,'c606f03801c706ee380300'),(0xbb13,'6668ff00ff006668da00ff00')]:
        b=bytes.fromhex(h);assert c[addr:addr+len(b)]==b,hex(addr)
    assert c[0xbab3:0xbab7]==bytes.fromhex('81fb0001')
    assert c[0xba77:0xba7c]==bytes.fromhex('8b16547e42')
    assert c[0xba7c:0xba81]==bytes.fromhex('833e527e02')
    assert c[0xba85:0xba8a]==bytes.fromhex('833e527e03')
    assert c[0xba8c:0xba8f]==bytes.fromhex('83fa0a')
    assert c[0xacee:0xacf6]==bytes.fromhex('6668000002006a42')
    assert c[0xacf6]==0x9a and struct.unpack_from('<H',c,0xacf7)[0]==0xe3b0
    assert c[0xbb01]==0x9a and struct.unpack_from('<H',c,0xbb02)[0]==0xacee
    state,events,remap,self_map=step(FlashState(123,9),1,0,True,remap=bytes(range(256)))
    assert state==FlashState(80,0) and remap[0xda]==0xda and self_map==0xda
    assert all(remap[i]==i for i in range(256) if i!=0xda)
    _,_,all_da,_=step(FlashState(123,9),1,0,True,remap=bytes([0xda])*256)
    assert all_da[0xda]==0xda and all(all_da[i]==0xdb for i in range(256) if i!=0xda)
    for i in range(80):state,ev,_,_=step(state,1,0);assert ev==[]
    state,ev,_,_=step(state,1,0);assert state==FlashState(3,1) and ev==[('palette',218,255,255,255)]
    for i in range(3):state,ev,_,_=step(state,1,0);assert ev==[]
    state,ev,_,_=step(state,1,0,random_value=41)
    assert state==FlashState(201,0) and ev==[('rng',),('palette',218,0,0,0),('sound',66,0,2)]
    for episode,level in [(2,0),(2,9),(3,0),(3,8)]:
        old=FlashState(123,1);assert step(old,episode,level)==(old,[],None,None)
        assert step(old,episode,level,True,remap=b'\xda')==(old,[],b'\xda',None)
    assert enabled(3,9) and not enabled(3,32767)
    counts=[]
    for r in range(32768):
        s,e,_,_=step(FlashState(0,1),1,0,random_value=r)
        assert 160<=s.countdown<=399 and len(e)==3
        counts.append(s.countdown)
    summary=dict(palette_index_hex='0xda',initial_countdown=80,initial_update_calls_until_white=81,
        white_countdown=3,white_update_calls_until_black=4,random_values_tested=32768,
        black_countdown_min=min(counts),black_countdown_max=max(counts),black_update_calls_min=161,
        black_update_calls_max=400,sound_slot=66,sound_arg1=0,sound_arg2=2,
        remap_rewrite='DA->DB in256 bytes atDS:8094, then table[DA]=DA',
        self_mapping_write='DS:816e = DS:8094+DA, written DA',runtime_tests=0,
        duration_seconds_proven=False,asset_identity_proven=False)
    (root/'pass6/flash_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

import csv,struct,json,hashlib

ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',p,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',p,ne+0x22)[0];shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',p,ne+0x32)[0]
def code(si):
    off,n,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',p,st+(si-1)*8);return p[off<<shift:(off<<shift)+n]
rows=list(csv.DictReader((root/'pass6/switch_targets.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t'))
for seg,table,count in [('1000',0xd360,8),('1000',0x6f95,20),('1008',0x191d,13)]:

    exported=[int(x['target'][5:],16) for x in rows if x['table']==f'{seg}:{table:04x}']
    assert list(targets)==exported
for value in range(65536):
    assert (value<=7)==(value in range(8))
    file_error_index=(value-1)&65535
    assert (file_error_index<=12)==(1<=value<=13)
    normalized=((value&0xfff0)-0xf000)&65535
    index_bytes=normalized>>3
    if index_bytes<=0x26:

        assert 0xf000<=value<=0xf13f
c1=code(1);c2=code(2)
for addr,h in [(0xd350,'3d0700'),(0xd35b,'2effa760d3'),(0x6f7e,'24f02d00f0'),
               (0x6f87,'c1e8033d2600'),(0x6f90,'2effa7956f')]:

assert c2[0x190f:0x1913]==bytes.fromhex('483d0c00')
assert c2[0x1918:0x191d]==bytes.fromhex('2effa71d19')
strings=list(csv.DictReader((root/'pass6/class_strings.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t'))
summary=dict(recovered_switch_table_words=41,existing_format_table_words_defined=8,
    switch_guard_input_cases=65536*3,
    class_string_new_count=sum(x['status']=='defined_from_descriptor_pointer' for x in strings),
    class_string_new_bytes=sum(len(x['text'])+1 for x in strings if x['status']=='defined_from_descriptor_pointer'),
    runtime_tests=0,complete_semantic_recovery=False)
